scope: FixedLivePair custody/pipes/gate/deadline/closure and typed public projection. No author mechanical checker or original ownership helper rerun.

findings.problem: A completed child is recomputed against the current clock on every pump. After exit+EOF was observed before its own deadline, subsequent log pumping can set completeBeforeDeadline back to false and immediately reject.

source_counterexample.nature: Static control-flow illustration; not an observed run
source_counterexample.result: The node completion changes true->false while the8-second log observation still has time.

findings.minimal_fix: Latch successful completion once exit+EOF was observed in time. Check each row's deadline only while it remains incomplete; preserve5/8/17 time bounds.

findings.problem: observe returns before START+17, but cached log projection, repeated input full reads and HOME fences still run under the default START+35 deadline before pair.close. These operations may consume the18-second reserve intended for two original9-second child cleanups.

source_counterexample.nature: Static allowed deadline path; not an observed run
source_counterexample.result: The second child cleanup can be rejected after the first consumes its unchanged bound.

findings.minimal_fix: After successful observe(), immediately call the original pair.close under critical protection before cached projection/fences. Retain final once-guarded close for exceptional paths. Alternatively bound all pre-cleanup work by17 without extending any deadline.

reviewed_boundaries: Five fixed executable inputs, six control HOME descriptors and four empty HOME descriptors plus five parent pipe ends give20 enumerated parent descriptors. Popen/loader internal temporaries are explicitly excluded from that enumeration.

The two row and pipe-slot intents are recorded before Popen. A failed Popen or incomplete returned-pipe transfer remains pending/UNKNOWN. Pipe close attempts are once-guarded; cleanup is not inferred from a missing record.

Actual direct-child capture binds PID,PPID,PGID,UID and birth. Exit observations use original WNOWAIT and never poll/reap before pipe capture. Signal authority comes only from retained Popen custody and the original helper.
The Node carrier waits for the single G byte, with exact PID-ready and release markers; its same-PID exec chain is only source/marker evidence. Final kernel image is not independently claimed.
The predicate uses only the actual new PID and three fixed origins. Gate warmup and a live log process are explicitly not subscription ACKs.

Projection accepts only typed consistent known fields, measured timestamp window, exact current subject and explicit deny grammar. Unknown message text, hashes and key names are not exported; only bounded public resource grammar may expose a resource string. No empty-result absence or root-cause inference is granted.

Commands.qualification: The after embeds the original qualified c102 helper. The immediate before embeds the public-version variant; do not call their entire modules byte-identical.
